title: Arista Networks Q1 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At March 31, 2026, cash and cash equivalents were USD 2.7895 billion and marketable securities were USD 9.5637 billion; diluted weighted-average shares were 1.2738 billion and non-cancellable purchase commitments remained a disclosed risk.
summary: The filing confirms Arista's balance-sheet liquidity, diluted share base, customer concentration, supply commitments and competitive risks used in the bounded valuation and risk review.
